title: Implement V4 Roslyn syntax and semantic detectors
goal: Use package-owned Roslyn inspection to enforce five source claims without building or executing the target repository.
acceptanceCriteria: Roslyn is loaded from a declared .NET SDK prerequisite with no network dependency.
Pre detects forbidden imports, disabled branches and declaration placement.
Post detects forbidden bound symbols and public member/payload types.
All five claims emit layered findings and non-zero coverage, while missing source fails explicitly.
No target build outputs are created and P0-P4B remain green.
Current V3 behavior remains unchanged with no active workflow or remote change.
